axis_rationale: Jono: optimize primarily for efficiency; symptoms = Phase-2 token cost (dominant lever), sectioning quality, script correctness. NOT spec/output drift (channel-vs-author etc. intentionally out of scope).

composite.efficiency_score_per_probe: 1 - min(1, phase2_read_bytes / full_body_bytes). phase2_read_bytes = total bytes the agent Reads into context during Phase-2 sectioning (summed from the subagent's Read-tool trace). Baseline route re-reads the whole clip => ~0.
composite.guardrail_REVERT_regardless: mean(assertion_pass_rate) < 0.90*baseline_assertion  OR  mean(judge_score) < 0.90*baseline_judge. Efficiency gains that regress sectioning quality or script correctness are reverted no matter the composite.

split.note: held-out probes (E3,E5,E8) are NEVER shown to the hypothesis/mutation steps; scoring only.

long_anchor: $SECOND_BRAIN_PATH/raw/clips/2026-06-20-huberman-peptides-bakri-readable-transcript.md (resolved by harness.py via SAVETOBRAIN_EVAL_ANCHOR / SECOND_BRAIN_PATH in ~/.jstack/config.env)

probes.intent: Phase-1 cleaning correctness: artifacts, filler, NAME_FIXES.
assertions: real words not mangled: 'adenosine','caffeine','tissue' still intact
probes.judge_rubric: Cleaned text reads naturally; no over-deletion of legitimate words; sentence flow preserved. [0,1].

probes.intent: Frontmatter + slug correctness from a messy title.
probes.input: title='Peptides: The Science, Uses & Safety!! | Dr. Abud Bakri (Ep. 12)' through slugify()+build_frontmatter()
assertions: slug matches ^[a-z0-9-]+$ with no leading/trailing '-' and no '--'
frontmatter has exactly the keys: title, source, channel, video_id, duration, published, collected, tags
probes.judge_rubric: Slug is human-recognizable from the title (not truncated mid-word into nonsense). [0,1].

probes.intent: Phase-2 short clip: right granularity at LOW token cost.
assertions: body integrity: output with all '## ...' lines removed == cleaned input char-for-char
probes.judge_rubric: Section boundaries fall at genuine topic shifts (sleep -> caffeine), headings descriptive. [0,1].

probes.intent: Flat monologue with no real topic shifts: must NOT over-segment.
assertions: no fabricated heading that names a topic absent from the text
probes.judge_rubric: Agent recognized a single coherent block; did not invent artificial structure. [0,1].

probes.intent: Medium clip with a sponsor break + Q&A: capture real boundaries.
assertions: one heading clearly marks the sponsor segment (matches /sponsor|eight ?sleep/i)
one heading clearly marks the audience Q&A (matches /q&a|question/i)
probes.judge_rubric: Sponsor and Q&A boundaries placed correctly; science blocks coherent; granularity appropriate for ~length. [0,1].

probes.intent: Documented run-path in the route must resolve to a real script (current spec path is broken).
probes.input: parse the python3 invocation path from references/youtube-route.md Phase 1
assertions: the script path quoted in youtube-route.md expands to an existing file on disk
that path is the same file as scripts/youtube-capture.py in the skill dir
probes.judge_rubric: A fresh agent copy-pasting the documented command would actually run the script. [0,1].

probes.intent: PRIMARY efficiency probe: section a 2h48m / 197KB transcript without paying full-transcript context.
assertions: every heading starts with '## ' and <= 8 words
body integrity preserved char-for-char (concat of section bodies minus heading lines == cleaned transcript)
phase2_read_bytes < 0.25 * full_body_bytes  (must NOT re-read the whole 197KB to insert headings)
probes.judge_rubric: Section count and placement appropriate for a ~3h interview; headings track real topic blocks (intro, BPC-157, GLP-1s, sponsors, Q&A...). [0,1].

probes.intent: Body-integrity invariant: sectioning inserts headings ONLY, never rewrites prose.
assertions: removing every line matching ^## .*$ from the output yields a string byte-identical to the cleaned input
no word in the cleaned input is added, dropped, or reordered
probes.judge_rubric: Output is provably headings-over-original, not a paraphrase. [0,1].
